data.name: Header_Intro
data.value: Hemodialysis filters your blood when your kidneys no longer can. Each session lasts several hours, under continuous monitoring.

data.name: Header_ImageAlt
data.value: A nurse adjusts a dialysis station monitor during a session.

data.name: Step1
data.value: Check-in and vitals — weight, blood pressure.

data.name: Step3
data.value: Connection to the generator by the care team.

data.name: Step5
data.value: Disconnection and a final check before you leave.

data.name: Frequency_Body
data.value: Most patients come in 3 times a week. Your nephrologist adjusts this rhythm to your condition.

data.name: Prepare_Item1
data.value: An ID and your medical file.

data.name: Prepare_Item2
data.value: Something to pass the time — a book, music, a tablet.

data.name: Prepare_Item3
data.value: A light snack, if your diet allows it.

data.name: Prepare_ImageAlt
data.value: A nurse accompanies a patient in a wheelchair through a corridor of the centre.

data.name: Cta_Title
data.value: A question before your first session?
